script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying there was nothing between princess and slave adds a detail about the transition that the text does not give.
“Still working for her” implies her friends had previously worked for her. The passage does not say that.
The kitchen comparison does not give betrayal and serving a clear shared action, so the joke does not readily make sense.
The absence of comfort does not establish that none of her lovers showed up. The explanation also adds what made the night long.
The text says no one comforts her, not that nobody knocks on her door.
The passage says the princes lack strength to flee; it does not say whether they have the strength to fight.
The passage says the enemies looked upon her, not that they stared.
Not considering her end does not establish that she was not watching it come. Calling the stains real also treats the poem's imagery as literal.
The passage calls the downfall astounding and says she did not consider her end. It does not say she was surprised by it or did not see it coming.
The passage does not say whether the nations entered by mistake or knew they were forbidden.
“The treasures go first” adds an order to what the people traded. The verse does not give one.
The Lord's rejection of the mighty men does not establish that they received no help.
